messages:
nora (release): opening thread for eu-west v2 push. window starts in 10m. goal: gated header migration + small canary (1%) for 15m. release notes posted to internal changelog.

deploy-bot: deploy intent recorded: service=api-gateway target=v2 region=eu-west-1 canary=1% window=15m id=deploy-6311302468

alejandro (deploy): quick reminder: header feature flag must be off for clients opt-in. we'll do an operator quiesce on old header parsing to avoid double-processing.

kai (runtime): baseline perf looks good. added extra logging for header-normalize path. please watch 95th latency and error-rate on /v2/chat.

deploy-bot: canary started. routing v2=1% v1=99% in eu-west-1.

lucy (cs): flagged 3 EU enterprise accounts that enabled strict header checks last month. recommending tenant-pins for them temporarily.

drew (sre): alert: error-rate for canary rose to 0.6% (threshold 0.3%). sampling traces show 400s due to missing Accept-Version header -> v2 rejects.

nora (release): ok, two options: 1) rollback canary, 2) pin affected tenants to v1 + gateway shim to inject Accept-Version header when absent. prefer (2) to avoid full rollback.

alejandro (deploy): propose commands: `tenant-pin --tenants tenant:orbit,tenant:pegasus --target v1 --region eu-west-1` and `deploy-bot add-shim --route /v2 --inject-header "Accept-Version: v1" --scope=10%`

deploy-bot: executing tenant-pin and shim deploy (dry-run=false).

deploy-bot: tenant-pin complete: tenant:orbit tenant:pegasus -> v1. shim deployed to 10% v2 slice. routing: v1=95% v2=5%. (op-id=op-e4f7) :white_check_mark:

kai (runtime): logs show immediate drop in 400s for pinned tenants. overall error-rate back to 0.12%. keeping the 5% for investigation and telemetry.

lucy (cs): sent targeted notification to orbit and pegasus account owners: "temporary pin to v1 while we finalize header migration; ETA 90m."

drew (sre): muting the canary 400 alert for eu-west-1 for 60m while we validate the shim. will expire automatically.

nora (release): I'm locking the public changelog entry with a note: "partial rollout, tenant pins in effect for select EU customers. do not lift notes until full validation." Will follow up at +30m. :eyes:
